joseph-crawford-she-s-my-wife.text: Packed our bags, left the kids behind,
Just me and you, a little us time.
Headed out west, chasing a getaway,
Niagara Falls was calling our names.
We suited up in tan from head to toe,
Two Frog Togg lovers, ready for the show.
The guide pulled up with a grin on her face,
Said, "You two planning to get wet today?"
I said, "You bet, that's why we're here!"
She laughed and said, "I've got news, my dear.
The boats don't run this time of year,
You're dressed for a splash, but there ain't one here!"
Well, we might've missed that boat ride fun,
But that sure didn't mean our night was done.
Found some good food, had a few cold drinks,
Hit the dance floor without a second thought to think.
She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
She's the reason everything feels right.
Through the highs and lows, through wrong and right,
She's the one I wanna hold every night.
And when our time on this earth is through,
I'll still be right there beside her too.
When the world moves on and the stars go dark,
I'll find her again, wherever ghosts are.
She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
And I'd choose her again a thousand times.
We've traveled roads that weren't always smooth,
Had our ups and downs, had some things to prove.
But through every season, every twist and turn,
She's the kind of love that never stops being worth the work.
She's been beside me when I needed her most,
The hand I reach for, the one I hold close.
And if there's one thing I know is true,
My favorite part of life is living it with you.
She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
She's the reason everything feels right.
Through the highs and lows, through wrong and right,
She's the one I wanna hold every night.
And when our time on this earth is through,
I'll still be right there beside her too.
When the world moves on and the stars go dark,
I'll find her again, wherever ghosts are.
She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
And I'd choose her again a thousand times.
I don't need a mansion, don't need a crown,
Don't need the whole world to be figured out.
Just give me her hand and a little more time,
A thousand tomorrows with her next to mine.
And if forever means we never say goodbye,
Then I'll love her beyond this lifetime.
She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
My once-in-a-lifetime, my reason why.
Through every storm and every mile,
I'd do it all again just to see her smile.
And when these hearts stop beating someday,
When this old world fades away,
I'll find her again on the other side,
Still holding her hand, still calling her mine.
She's my WIFE, she's my LIFE,
Even when we're ghosts, she'll be by my side.
Through every lifetime, whatever comes true,
I'd find my way back to her, like I always do.
Two tan suits and a boat that wouldn't go,
A night of dancing and nowhere else to go.
Funny how the little things become our favorite memories...
She's my WIFE...
She's my LIFE...
And she's my forever.
